name: Cache Builder
description: Survives by distributing supplies across multiple hidden locations
behavioral_signature: Always has something stashed nearby no matter where they are
under_stress: Can't remember which caches have been found or depleted
at_rest: Maintaining, rotating, and concealing supply drops
will_always: prepare for scarcity before it arrives
will_never: keep all their resources in one place
unless: they're forced to consolidate for a final stand
